name: hou_mcp_relationship_aware_layout
description: Consume a pre-built RelationshipGraph and produce relationship-enforced world-space transforms. Enforces all semantic rules: fireplace snaps to wall, chairs orbit table, bottles land on surfaces (never floor), barrels stay at perimeter. Returns relationship_score (PASS ≥ 0.95) and per-rule validation flags. Must run after hou_mcp_relationship_graph_builder and before CollisionSolver.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.layout.relationship_graph_builder import RelationshipGraph
from src.runtime.layout.relationship_layout_engine import (
    get_relationship_layout_engine,
    RELATIONSHIP_LAYOUT_STATUS_PASS,
    RELATIONSHIP_LAYOUT_STATUS_FAIL,
)

class Hou_Mcp_Relationship_Aware_Layout(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_relationship_aware_layout"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("assets_json",  "string", widget_type="text", default="[]")
        self.add_input("graph_json",   "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("shell_json",   "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_output("transforms_json",           "string")
        self.add_output("relationship_score",         "float")
        self.add_output("supported_objects_json",     "string")
        self.add_output("wall_attached_objects_json", "string")
        self.add_output("orphan_relationships_json",  "string")
        self.add_output("status",                     "string")
        self.add_output("exec_out_fail",              "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        _empty = {"transforms_json": "[]", "relationship_score": 0.0,
                  "supported_objects_json": "[]", "wall_attached_objects_json": "[]",
                  "orphan_relationships_json": "[]",
                  "status": RELATIONSHIP_LAYOUT_STATUS_FAIL,
                  "exec_out": False, "exec_out_fail": True}

        try:
            assets = json.loads((inputs.get("assets_json") or "[]").strip() or "[]")
        except Exception:
            self.log_error("assets_json is not valid JSON.")
            return _empty

        try:
            graph_dict = json.loads((inputs.get("graph_json") or "{}").strip() or "{}")
            graph      = RelationshipGraph.from_dict(graph_dict)
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"graph_json parse error: {e}")
            return _empty

        try:
            shell_dict = json.loads((inputs.get("shell_json") or "{}").strip() or "{}")
        except Exception:
            shell_dict = {}

        result = get_relationship_layout_engine().build_layout(
            scene_assets=assets,
            relationship_graph=graph,
            environment_shell=shell_dict,
        )

        for err in result.validation_errors:
            self.log_error(f"[RelLayout] {err}")
        for w in result.warnings:
            self.log_warning(f"[RelLayout] {w}")
        if result.orphan_relationships:
            self.log_warning(f"[RelLayout] Orphan relationships: {result.orphan_relationships}")

        is_fail = result.status == RELATIONSHIP_LAYOUT_STATUS_FAIL
        return {
            "transforms_json":           json.dumps([t.to_dict() for t in result.relationship_aware_transforms], sort_keys=True, indent=2),
            "relationship_score":         result.relationship_score,
            "supported_objects_json":     json.dumps(result.supported_objects, sort_keys=True),
            "wall_attached_objects_json": json.dumps(result.wall_attached_objects, sort_keys=True),
            "orphan_relationships_json":  json.dumps(result.orphan_relationships, sort_keys=True),
            "status":                     result.status,
            "exec_out":      not is_fail,
            "exec_out_fail": is_fail,
        }

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Relationship_Aware_Layout
